reason: The README clearly describes a multi-agent orchestration plugin that decomposes goals into persistent, dependency-aware top-level tasks, runs independent work in parallel, preserves separate contexts, and supports local tools, MCPs, workflows, verification, and CLI control.

summaries.zh: All in Luna 将复杂目标拆分为具备独立上下文和依赖关系的顶层任务，协调并行执行、子代理工作、结果汇总与运行恢复。
summaries.en: All in Luna orchestrates complex goals as persistent top-level tasks with separate contexts, dependency-aware parallel execution, local subagents, result aggregation, and resumable runs.

capabilities: Decomposes goals into independent top-level tasks
Schedules tasks according to dependencies and parallelism
Maintains separate task contexts and persistent run state
Uses subagents, tools, Skills, and MCPs within tasks
Runs verification such as tests, builds, and output checks
Provides CLI commands to start, inspect, and drive runs
May reach external mutations or credential-dependent actions when explicitly authorized
